# ⚔️ XTALE PvP Pack ### Dominate Every Fight. A competitive PvP texture pack crafted for players who demand maximum visibility, cleaner visuals, and a professional combat experience.
--- # ✨ Why XTALE? Most PvP packs either look amazing or perform well. **XTALE does both.** Built around visibility, consistency, and combat performance, every texture has been refined to help you react faster and fight better without sacrificing Minecraft's iconic style. --- ## ⚔️ Combat Optimizations > Designed specifically for competitive PvP. ✔ Short Swords ✔ Smaller Tools ✔ Cleaner Item Models ✔ Reduced Screen Clutter ✔ Better Enemy Visibility ✔ Improved Hit Registration Feel ✔ More Focus During Combat --- ## ❤ Enhanced HUD Stay informed without distractions. - Improved Hearts - Improved Armor Bar - Cleaner GUI - Better Experience Bar - Easier Status Tracking - Improved Visual Feedback --- ## 🎨 Vanilla+ Style XTALE isn't meant to completely replace Minecraft's art style. Instead, it enhances it. - Vanilla Friendly - Modernized Textures - Cleaner Inventory - Improved Icons - Better GUI Consistency - Competitive Aesthetic --- # 🖼 Showcase --- # 📦 Recommended Mods For the best possible experience: | Mod | Purpose | |------|----------| | OptiFine | Better visuals & compatibility | | Dark Loading Screen | Modern loading screens | | Skip Server Resource Packs | Faster server joining | --- # 🚀 Performance Unlike many modern PvP packs, XTALE focuses on keeping visuals clean without introducing unnecessary complexity. ✔ Lightweight ✔ FPS Friendly ✔ Multiplayer Ready ✔ Hypixel Friendly ✔ Survival Compatible ✔ Replay Mod Compatible --- # 📋 Changelog
